name: Jason Steward
description:
Jason Steward is the owner and president of Total Building Systems Inc., a commercial and residential construction company based in Cottonwood, Arizona. His professional profile also identifies him as a project manager with the company, a position listed as beginning in January 2000. His background combines company leadership and construction project management with involvement in the company’s interior construction services.

The company’s website identifies Jason as its primary contact for steel-stud framing, drywall, suspended ceilings and interior demolition. These services encompass the framing, wall, ceiling and demolition components involved in a variety of interior construction projects. Clients seeking information about these portions of Total Building Systems’ work are directed to Jason.

Jason has also publicly discussed his experience with Trusscore wall-panel installation. In a testimonial published by the manufacturer, he describes taking drywall installers who have never used Trusscore and seeing them become productive with the system within two or three hours. His comments provide evidence of practical involvement with installation methods and the introduction of alternative wall systems to installation crews.

His LinkedIn profile lists construction management studies at Yavapai College.
